meta.title: Project cognition index
meta.description: Maintains a plain-text, Git-versioned cognition map of each project (.cognition/ volumes with FRAS entries), so a session reads one index instead of re-discovering the codebase. Simplified re-implementation of the AOCI-CODE method.

cognition_overview.summary: Load the whole cognition map before working on a project; chunked delivery for large indexes, includes the database volume.

tools.cognition_init: Create the .cognition/ volume skeleton; agents_md=true also appends a managed rules block to AGENTS.md for cross-host portability.
tools.cognition_scan: Report missing/orphan/stale drift and a batched authoring plan.
tools.cognition_update_entries: Validate and write FRAS entries (code/database volumes).
tools.cognition_remove_entries: Drop entries whose files/tables were deleted.
tools.cognition_database_init: Import a .sql DDL dump as Schema Evidence and enable the database volume.
tools.cognition_verify: Re-validate every volume's entries; returns the alignment verdict.
tools.cognition_gate: Per-conversation gate: resolves the project against the whitelist/blacklist — blacklisted (do nothing), whitelisted (create or dynamically maintain the index), or unlisted (ask via the overlay question, then record the choice).
tools.cognition_registry: Maintain the project registry (~/.dsh/project-cognition.json): list shows both lists, decline blacklists, allow lifts a blacklist record, whitelist adds to the whitelist, unwhitelist removes it.
tools.cognition_doctor: Diagnose the cognition setup: volume skeleton, meta dictionaries, state integrity, schema evidence, drift, coverage, and index size; returns an itemized HEALTHY / WARN / FAIL report.
tools.cognition_search: Filter entries by tag, path, keyword, or project forward/reverse R relations; relations=impact walks the transitive reverse closure along formal R edges (derived impact analysis).

panel: Panel: inspect index status, drift, coverage, chunk plan, suggested next input, black/whitelists (with per-entry removal), and the verify verdict
